text: God! God! I am running to you for dear life; the chase is wild.
ripped to shreds by foes fierce as lions, dragged into the forest and left unlooked for, unremembered.
God, if I've done what they say—
ripped off my enemies— If my hands are really that dirty,
leave me flat on my face in the dirt.
against my furious enemies. Wake up, God.
throw out the false charges against me. I'm ready, confident in your verdict: "Innocent."
but publish your mandate for us. You get us ready for life: you probe for our soft spots, you knock off our rough edges.
but his nerves are sandpapered raw. Nobody gets by with anything.
Sword honed on his whetstone, bow strung, arrow on the string,
He had sex with sin, he's pregnant with evil. Oh, look! He's having the baby—a Lie-Baby!
digging, then concealing, his man-trap down that lonely stretch of road? Go back and look again—you'll see him in it headfirst, legs waving in the breeze.
I'm singing the fame of heaven-high God.
